question: What comprehensive division of eightfold groups is sought to be fully known?
premises: There is a division of eight groups of eight
This division is to be known fully
The knowledge sought is complete and extensive
inference: The complete division of the eight groups of eight is sought to be fully understood

plain_english: I wish to know fully and completely the division of the eight groups of eight.
